author: creative-producer
statement: nextWaypoint scans the entire polyline on every tick and selects the FIRST point farther than 1.2 units from the current body. Once the body leaves the initial point by more than 1.2 units, that already visited start becomes the next target again. Both the long survey rail and common rail pass their complete unsliced route to this stateless scan.
sourceCounterexample: At route[0], controller targets a later point. At a body pose 1.3 units along that first long segment, distance to route[0] is now >1.2, so the next frame targets route[0] again. This is a static source counterexample, not an observed completed browser run.
requestedRepair: Track ordered controller traversal/reconstruct it from actual recorded progress and current body, without granting route proof. Never retarget already passed points during ordinary forward walking. Reset or reconstruct correctly for Continue/revision/beat changes; real world/route predicates remain the sole progress authority. Add a multi-tick rail regression that physically follows emitted move targets through all turns on both signed polylines and reaches the far end without shortcuts or toggling back to start. Then prove actual browser movie flow.
